title: Row-Level Security
description: Implement Row-Level Security (RLS) on the 'documents' table. Each user should only see their own documents. Enable RLS, create a policy, and query as a specific user.
hints: ALTER TABLE documents ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
CREATE POLICY user_documents ON documents USING (owner = current_user)
Create a test user and grant SELECT on the table
SET ROLE test_user; SELECT * FROM documents; RESET ROLE;
